description.value:
North Oak, Poor. The best flat-pack money can buy, assembled by someone off a gig board, with a state-of-the-art smart home. The starting set for North Oak homes from rewards or Exec rank, and the neighbours notice.

−4 to social checks with North Oak residents and −2 with corpos in general while any room you live in has it. +1 to Humanity Gain rolls and the monthly credit.

Bought per room: set the amount to how many rooms you furnish. Rentals come with a basic set; break it and you pay for a new one. A new set arrives and is installed within the month.
